name: Range mode - failed auction to POC
thesis: In a balanced open, pokes beyond the value-area edge that fail (trapped traders) snap back to the POC - high WR, small target.
rules: Volume profile of 9:30-10:00 ET, value area 70%. After it, when price pokes beyond VAH/VAL and fails back inside, fade it: stop beyond the poke extreme, target POC (or the opposite edge).
